comment: GNU build tools at the versions of upstream's Ubuntu 24.04 build host, built from verified sources into tmp/rpl-tools in this order. Tasks run autoreconf/autogen, so autoconf/automake/libtool shape the generated configure scripts (CPython 3.12 requires autoconf 2.71). GNU make 4.3 replaces Apple's make 3.81, whose one-second timestamp resolution skips CPython's makesetup step when Modules/Setup is written in the same second as the Makefile. GNU libtool is installed as glibtool/glibtoolize so Apple's libtool stays available.

aclocal.comment: Installed into <prefix>/share/aclocal. pkg.m4 is /usr/share/aclocal/pkg.m4 of Ubuntu 24.04 pkgconf 1.8.1-2build1 (serial 12, pkg-config-0.29.2); aclocal needs it to regenerate CPython's and other configure scripts.
